lineage: NEW. Not a variant of EXP-ARP-008: the signal is a cross-sectional breadth aggregate over the whole eligible universe, not a per-asset close-vs-lookback rule.
mechanism_statement: Market timing from the SHARE of eligible assets trading above their own moving average; the traded object is an equal-weight basket, so no single-asset trend is selected.

rules.signal: breadth B_t = fraction of PIT-eligible universe with close_t > SMA50_t
rules.entry: enter long equal-weight eligible universe when B_t >= 0.55
rules.exit: exit to flat when B_t <= 0.45 (hysteresis band; no re-entry inside the band)
rules.rebalance: daily at UTC close; act next open
rules.position: one basket position at a time; fixed total notional 500 USD; no compounding

spec_contract.entry_rule: enter long basket when breadth(B>=0.55); act next open
spec_contract.exit_rule: exit to flat when breadth(B<=0.45); act next open

implementation_config.entry_rule: enter long basket when breadth(B>=0.55); act next open
implementation_config.exit_rule: exit to flat when breadth(B<=0.45); act next open
implementation_config.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — pre-registration only; no DEV execution in ARP-008

kill_criteria: DEV gross expectancy <= cost bps -> REJECT_COSTS
single trade > 50% of positive DEV net -> REJECT_FRAGILE

gates.promotion: positive net DEV AND positive net VALIDATION AND cost PASS AND robustness PASS AND PIT PASS AND contract PASS AND sample sufficient AND concentration acceptable AND builder != verifier
